name: nc-early-vote-sites
description: Find NC early voting sites by county, with hours and the closest site to an address

scripts.build: squint compile && mkdir -p dist && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js dist/ && esbuild out/main.mjs --bundle --format=iife --target=es2019 --minify --outfile=dist/bundle.js && esbuild style.css --bundle --minify --external:*.png --outfile=dist/style.css
scripts.watch: mkdir -p dist && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js dist/ && squint watch & esbuild out/main.mjs --bundle --format=iife --target=es2019 --minify --outfile=dist/bundle.js --watch & esbuild style.css --bundle --minify --external:*.png --outfile=dist/style.css --watch
